LOW_HIGH.action: Do not declare safety; request telemetry verification

recommended_actions.NORMAL: Maintain routine environmental surveillance. No immediate action required.
recommended_actions.MONITOR: Increase telemetry sampling frequency. Monitor weather forecasts and reservoir levels.
recommended_actions.PREPARE: Activate preparedness protocols. Pre-position flood response teams. Alert vulnerable communities.
recommended_actions.ALERT: Deploy local flood response teams. Issue public warnings for high-risk zones. Verify reservoir telemetry.
recommended_actions.EMERGENCY: Full emergency mobilization. Evacuate high-risk low-lying areas. Open emergency operations center.

verification_templates.HIGH_UNCERTAINTY: Verify prediction with independent meteorological source before full escalation
verification_templates.DEGRADED_TELEMETRY: Confirm observation data from backup or manual field verification
verification_templates.STALE_RESERVOIR: Request manual reservoir gauge reading from CMWSSB field operator
verification_templates.CROSS_SOURCE_DISAGREEMENT: Reconcile conflicting satellite and ground station measurements
verification_templates.ANOMALY_DETECTED: Inspect flagged anomalous sensor reading for hardware fault or extreme event
verification_templates.CRITICAL_ASSET_EXPOSED: Dispatch rapid infrastructure assessment team to high-risk asset
verification_templates.BLOCKED_DATA: Decision confidence severely degraded; require manual situation assessment before action
